item.title: Economic and business updates for the community
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Local economic and business leaders from around the area gathered Wednesday to hear from elected officials and a member of the regional chamber.

item.title: Devin Fitzgerald begins Notre Dame career, following NFL legacy
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Notre Dame Fighting Irish football added several midyear freshmen to its roster this spring, including a familiar last name in wide receiver Devin Fitzgerald.

item.title: Notre Dame hires Aaron Henry as defensive backs coach, co-defensive coordinator
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Notre Dame Fighting Irish football has hired former Illinois Fighting Illini football defensive coordinator Aaron Henry as its new co-defensive coordinator, replacing Mike Mickens, who left to join the Baltimore Ravens.

item.title: Republican party leaders challenge Dan Schaetzle's re-election eligibility
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Republican party leaders are challenging councilmember Dan Schaetzle's right to run for re-election this year.

item.title: Lasalle Grill’s last call after 35 years
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — The LaSalle Grill downtown South Bend is closing its doors for good after dinner Wednesday night, ending nearly 35 years as one of the city’s most celebrated fine dining destinations.

item.title: Mayor Mueller shares his support for AI data center development
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- South Bend mayor, James Mueller, reiterated his support for the development of AI data centers in Michiana on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Three-vehicle collision at C.R. 146 and S.R. 15: disregard of a stop sign
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- At approximately 1:33 p.m. on Wednesday, a three-vehicle crash occurred in New Paris at the intersection of C.R. 146 and S.R. 15.

item.title: Michigan man arrested for possession of counterfeit bills
item.description: VAN BUREN COUNTY, Mich. -- On Wednesday, troopers from the Paw Paw Post in Van Buren County responded to reports of forgery/counterfeiting after two suspects had used counterfeit currency in a Facebook Marketplace purchase of a designer belt.

item.title: Art on display at Black Voices Art Show
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- Wednesday evening, the Goshen Theatre hosted the Black Voices Art Show where four artists displayed their art to the community.

item.title: Elkhart Launches Small Business Resource Guide to Support Local Entrepreneurs
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Entrepreneurs, business owners and city leaders gathered Wednesday at the Lerner Theatre to launch a new effort aimed at strengthening small businesses across Elkhart.
